adaptation.mechanism: nuisance-matched directional causal-specificity receipt with PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN verdicts, deterministic digest, and fail-closed UNKNOWN on required control mismatch
adaptation.hardening: all supplied numeric evidence and nuisance-relative differences must be finite; nuisance-relative differences must be non-negative

excluded_claims: the receipt performs the underlying intervention experiment
PASS authorizes model, memory, provider, or protected effects
SPM model weights, LoRA adapters, training data, or memory-specialist runtime are imported
